question.text: Under the SEBI Stewardship Code referenced in Ch 12 (ESG section), AIFs are required to:

answer.text: File monthly ESG scoreboards with SEBI for each investee company.
Monitor and engage, in collaboration with other institutional investors, on ESG factors and monitor the inherent ESG risks at the investee company level.
Divest from any investee company with an ESG score below 70.
Outsource ESG monitoring to a SEBI-approved ESG rating agency.

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 12 ESG section: 'Under the SEBI Stewardship Code all AIFs in collaboration with other institutional investors, are required to monitor and engage with the investee companies on ESG factors and monitor the inherent ESG risks at the investee company level.' The Trap: A, C, D are fabricated. Cross-Exam Context: Stewardship Code applies to MFs, AIFs, insurers, pension funds. Also tested in XXI-B (PM) and X-A (IA). Manager's Pro-Tip: Run a single annual 'ESG stewardship report' covering all portfolio companies — cover board composition, environmental KPIs, employee grievance mechanisms. Share with LPs proactively.
